title: Technical Training
description:
You served your apprenticeship in a Landenheit guild, filling notebook after notebook with diagrams and formulae.

The first time you {{memorisee|memorise}} {{FORTEC-001|this Skill}}, choose an {{aptitude}} from {{artisanat}}, {{arcanes}}, {{technologie}} and {{science}}. While {{FORTEC-001|this Skill}} is {{memorisee}}, you have {{expertise}} in that {{aptitude}}.
